original_text:
From Dr . Simone:

To all students out there:

I have recently joined Khalifa University (Abu Dhabi), Department of Earth Sciences, and I am looking for outstanding candidates for PhD positions starting in January 2027. 
Applications are now open and will close on 31 𝐀𝐮𝐠𝐮𝐬𝐭 2026. 
I would be especially happy to hear from excellent applicants worldwide (quality and motivation are what matter most).

𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐜𝐡 𝐝𝐢𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 (𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐛𝐞 𝐜𝐨-𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐭)
I am building a research group focusing on “big-picture” solid Earth questions, with two main directions:

1) Seismology / Tomography 
New constraints on the lithosphere and upper mantle of the Arabian Plate and/or polar regions using new and/or integrated datasets (teleseismic imaging, lithospheric structure, and tectono-magmatic interpretation).

2) Computational Geodynamics (Thermal Lattice Boltzmann)
High-resolution numerical simulations of magma-ocean / early Earth dynamics / planetary geodynamics / tectonic processes, with room for original ideas and projects built from scratch together with the student.

𝐖𝐡𝐨 𝐚𝐦 𝐈 𝐥𝐨𝐨𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐟𝐨𝐫?
Curious, highly motivated people with an independent mindset.
You do not need to arrive fully trained, but you should enjoy reasoning, troubleshooting, working with data/models, and writing clearly. Backgrounds in Physics, Geology, Geophysics, Applied Mathematics (or related fields) are all welcome.

𝐅𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐮𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭
Khalifa University offers very generous, tier-based PhD scholarships that include full tuition coverage, a monthly stipend, and additional benefits (e.g., accommodation and medical insurance, yearly flight tickets to home country)

𝐇𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐲
Applications are submitted through the KU admissions portal. ...

𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐜𝐭 (𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐲𝐢𝐧𝐠)
If you are interested, feel free to email me at simone.pilia@ku.ac.ae with a short CV and a brief paragraph about your interests/skills.
chinese_translation:
来自Simone博士：

致所有学生：

我最近加入了哈利法大学（阿布扎比）地球科学系，正在寻找优秀候选人申请2027年1月开始的博士职位。
申请现已开放，截止日期为2026年8月31日。
特别欢迎全球优秀申请者（质量和动力最为重要）。

研究方向（可与学生共同设计）：
1) 地震学/层析成像：使用新数据集对阿拉伯板块和/或极地地区的岩石圈和上地幔提供新约束。
2) 计算地球动力学（热格子玻尔兹曼）：岩浆海洋/早期地球动力学/行星地球动力学/构造过程的高分辨率数值模拟。

寻找：好奇心强、高度积极、独立思维的人。背景可来自物理、地质、地球物理、应用数学等相关领域。

资助：哈利法大学提供慷慨的分级博士奖学金，包括全额学费、月津贴及住宿、医疗保险、每年回国机票等。

联系：申请前可发邮件至 simone.pilia@ku.ac.ae，附简短CV和兴趣/技能简述。
research_focus: Seismology, tomography, computational geodynamics, solid Earth sciences
application_notes: Deadline: 31 August 2026; Start January 2027; Contact simone.pilia@ku.ac.ae with CV; Generous scholarships including stipend, accommodation, insurance

2️⃣ Mangrove Restoration, Carbon Stocks & Ecotourism Value Chains, Setiu Wetlands

Master’s degree in:  Mangrove Ecology

Prepare your CV, cover letter, and academic transcripts.
